_comment: Standard non-member delivery rules for the seed's single scenario (#4), in the seed's rule format.
Researched on 26 Sep 2026 from each retailer's own pages; evidence holds the quoted wording.
No retailer states a minimum order: their fee tables start below the free-delivery threshold with no floor, so minimumOrderCents is null.
Thresholds are inclusive ('$59 and above', 'min. $60 spend', 'S$80.00 and above').
thresholdIncludesMandatoryCharges has no effect in the MVP, which models no item charges.
scenario: A serviceable Singapore address, standard scheduled delivery, non-member pricing and no vouchers.

rules.caveats: RedMart's help centre could not be read by automated tools; the values come from the delivery panel on RedMart product pages, which matched all 30 listings in the Stage 2F spot-check. RedMart+ members get lower thresholds; the non-member values are used.

rules.note: S$5 delivery below S$59, plus a S$3.99 service fee on every order below S$300.

evidence.quote: $59* and above Delivery charge waived ... *Excluding delivery charges and products directly fulfilled by Marketplace sellers.
Yes, the service fee is a fixed fee that will be included for all online orders
Order Value (Incl. GST) Delivery Fee (Incl. Service Fee) $300 and above Waived Between $59 to $300 $3.99 Below $59 $8.99

rules.caveats: The service fee amount is derived: the event page's delivery-plus-service totals (S$8.99 below S$59, S$3.99 from S$59, waived from S$300) minus the help centre's delivery fee (S$5 below S$59, waived from S$59) give S$3.99, waived from S$300. Orders over 600 items pay S$26.75 delivery, outside the MVP's 50 lines x 20 packs. Digital Club members pay neither fee; the non-member values are used.

evidence.quote: For Order Value less than S$80.00 per delivery - S$7 Delivery Charge
For Order Value of S$80.00 and above per delivery - Free Delivery
Enjoy FREE delivery for orders above $80. A $7 delivery charge will be applied for orders below $80.

rules.caveats: The FAQ says 'above $80' and the terms say 'S$80.00 and above'; the terms are used, so S$80 exactly is free.
